Thank you for your understanding

notes.title: Delay in Release
notes.notes:
We wanted to reach out and let our community know that we are still playtesting, and have run into a small issue in gameplay, that prevents progress to the end game.  We have put in a request to move the release date back to the 15th of October which should allow us enough time to go through everything and figure out what's causing the problem.  

We are committed to delivering a a good experience to our community and players and could not in good conscience release with the game in this state, regardless of having an early access status.  Early Access is not a ticket for mediocrity and we want a Start to Finish experience for you all.  Rest assured the issue is a small one and will be sorted out promptly.  

Thank you
Micah Yarborough
Wildebeest labs
